definitions.explanation: The assorted smaller costs that come with a purchase or transaction on top of the main price — fees, taxes, insurance, and handling charges. Standard wording in real estate, car sales, and travel.

examples.japanese: {諸費用|しょひよう}は{別|べつ}にかかります。
{車|くるま}の{値段|ねだん}に{諸費用|しょひよう}を{加|くわ}えると{予算|よさん}を{超|こ}えてしまう。
examples.english: If you add the various fees to the price of the car, it goes over my budget.

examples.japanese: {家|いえ}を{買|か}うときは、{物件|ぶっけん}の{価格|かかく}だけでなく、{税金|ぜいきん}や{手数料|てすうりょう}などの{諸費用|しょひよう}も{計算|けいさん}に{入|い}れておく{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: When buying a house, you need to factor in not only the price of the property but also various costs such as taxes and handling fees.

notes:
The prefix {諸|しょ} (various, several) attached to {費用|ひよう} (expenses). It appears mainly in written quotes and contracts, where it covers items too numerous to list individually.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {諸費用|しょひよう}がかかる: for various costs to be incurred
- {諸費用|しょひよう}を{含|ふく}む: to include miscellaneous costs
- {諸費用|しょひよう}{込|こ}み: miscellaneous costs included

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {手数料|てすうりょう}: handling fee — one specific charge, often part of the {諸費用|しょひよう}
- {経費|けいひ}: expenses — costs a business incurs in operating, viewed from the accounting side
